scope: synthetic synchronous POSIX TCP IPv4 loopback; one reused connection and one in-flight request; injected lifecycle model is separate from actual network; no production async claim

fixture.wire: unchanged native-endian XWireHeaderV1 plus used_bytes payload; header_bytes=88; no added prefix or fields
fixture.processing: exact same fixture_value, processed_value, markers, labels and per-value checks as reference

cli.options: all listed options required exactly once; unknown/duplicate rejected; output file/dir must be new

exit_codes.130: external signal managed by queue; binary emits no success guarantee

timing.description: no per-stage timing probes; required steady-clock deadline checks remain

diagnostic.description: per-stage clock probes; never use as formal total-timing evidence

profiles.optimization: -O2 both; same source and flags except macro; sanitizer separate validation builds

pool.none: two default empty pool handles; no caching
pool.cold: two independent one-slot pools, server and client; clear both outside each iteration
pool.warm: same two pools; one full untimed roundtrip on same connection before measured iterations
pool.hard_budget: one request slot; reserve four max-wire logical byte credits before input allocation; request client immutable string + server input string + server saved owning output + client response string. Owner maximum capacities and two pool idle budgets are separate.
pool.budget_meaning: reserved_inflight_peak_bytes=4*max_wire is conservative logical admission credit, not measured std::string capacity, malloc overhead, RSS, VM accessible pages or owner/pool storage; no measured physical-memory claim
pool.budget_restoration: RAII RunReservation returns byte and queue credit on success or exception; success asserts both zero after owned request destruction; model subcases assert bytes/slots held while cancellation pending and restored only on terminal completion; actual smoke asserts owned socket count zero after all scoped cases

timing.begin: client immediately before first request send on established connection; immutable input already prepared
timing.end: client complete response receive, successful load_verified and exact marker/count/label/each-value verification finished
included: server owner release before response send
excluded: persistent server worker creation and final join
post-timer wait for server send completion and server input/output string destruction
timing.causal_note: server owner release is before response send and included causally; server send completion and server string destruction can trail client verification; server_completion_wait_outside_ns measures only residual wait after client owner release; do not add whole response_send_ns or server destructor durations to main because intervals overlap
timing.deferred_reclamation_metric: (end_to_end_ns+cold_clear_outside_ns+final_clear_outside_ns+client_owner_release_outside_ns+server_completion_wait_outside_ns)/iterations; sequential residual wait avoids overlapping server send/cleanup; still excludes pool/thread/connection setup, warmup, file writes, client response/request string destruction and scheduler gaps; not total application cost
timing.server_input_output_destruction: server input and owning output strings destruct after send_exact returns, before worker signals done; can overlap client receive/validation, residual completion wait outside main is measured separately
timing.client_destruction: client verifier owner release after main timer measured client_owner_release_outside_ns; response string destruction after output write, and immutable request string destruction after whole run, excluded and not separately timed

run.server_completion_wait_outside_ns: integer sum of residual worker waits after client release
run.exact_arrays: samples and output_files have exactly iterations entries; output-N.wire corresponds to samples[N] (N=0..iterations-1)

sample.server_completion_wait_outside_ns: integer residual wait after client owner release, outside main

smoke.case_ids: exact union of model_case_ids and tcp_case_ids
smoke.cases: array exact group inventory {id,scope,status=passed,subcase_count}; counters are in subcases, not manufactured group totals
smoke.scope: each case injected_model or actual_tcp or filesystem
smoke.subcases: exact frozen subcase IDs; each emits scope,parent_id,expected_reason,actual_reason, and all expected/actual counters; auditor compares to contract independently
smoke.backpressure_frame_bytes: integer; backpressure_wire_bytes symbol; large unchanged V1 fixture with524288 elements

failed.error: human detail; not sufficient for a negative test by itself

json.stdout: exactly one UTF-8 JSON object plus newline; no progress text on stdout; diagnostics may use stderr; externally killed process need not emit JSON

smoke.negative_rule: expected reason and exact/read-bounded progress, publication, allocation, resource and terminal count invariants checked; arbitrary exception never passes
smoke.counter_semantics: read/written count transport bytes actually checked for operation; pool roundtrip aggregate counts both endpoints over two exchanges; receive_allocations counts owning receive buffers (four across two exchanges); load-only supplementary cases count supplied wire bytes and one staging buffer; terminal_count=one per completed/failed operation, or2 for two complete exchanges. active_bytes/active_queue_frames are logical admission credits after terminal, not physical memory.
smoke.expectations: each flat expected_* field is golden; report actual counterpart must match golden; symbolic nonnegative byte expressions use only declared symbols and small integer multiplication/subtraction; reason and every counter checked in binary and independent auditor

resource_gate: C++ build/functional/sanitizer only after W4 ready AND parent notice; all via experiments/vm_coordination/run_job.py; W1 performs no performance matrix
production_async_status: not implemented; model lifecycle and synchronous POSIX adapter only

transport_deadlines.clock: steady_clock monotonic; absolute deadline; positive short I/O, EINTR and would-block never extend it
transport_deadlines.connection: one deadline constructed on entry connect_loopback, covers socket/bind/listen/connect/accept setup, timeout_ms from entry
transport_deadlines.client_exchange: after worker is ready, construct deadline immediately before main timer/start-send; request send and complete response receive share it; check before each socket attempt and bounded poll
transport_deadlines.server_exchange: worker starts one deadline immediately after accepting local task, covering complete request receive and response send with no reset; processing/load/save checked before subsequent network operation
transport_deadlines.cpu_validation: verified load/process/save/semantic checks are synchronous and not preemptible; check client exchange absolute deadline after successful semantic verification and before reporting success; overrun rejects even with complete bytes
transport_deadlines.isolated_smoke_operations: deadline constructed immediately before that isolated receive/send; incomplete header/payload peer held open times out; no read-to-EOF framing
transport_deadlines.completion: worker waiting start/finish uses condition variables; active network operations are deadline-bounded, shutdown wakes worker during unwinding
